# Timeline

One line per dated thing. The context pack reads this table: rows dated at or before
the chapter's year go into the prompt as "exists"; later rows go in as "does not exist
yet, do not mention". Keep the Year column a plain four-digit year.

| Year | Real events | In the novel |
|---|---|---|
| 1888 | | Ovide Nadeau builds the first ice house on Sable Pond |
| 1901 | | the pond house burns; Ovide rebuilds it in stone and sawdust |
| 1912 | | Odile is born in the scale house during a February cut |
| 1918 | the influenza reaches the coast | Ovide dies; his widow Celine keeps the books |
| 1922 | first household electric refrigerators sold in Rockland | the domestic route loses a third of its stops |
| 1929 | the Crash | the cannery cuts its summer ice order in half |
| 1931 | | the January cut is thin; Wilfred takes the crew onto black ice |
| 1934 | | the hoist rope parts and Marcel loses two fingers |
| 1938 | the September hurricane | the schooner Camille is lost off the ledges |
| 1942 | | the cannery converts to mechanical ice; the pond house closes |
| 1945 | the war ends | Odile sells the pond lot to the town for a landing |
